name: Trilinear Interpolation via Interleaved Fetches
definition: A technique to perform trilinear interpolation on a 3D volume texture stored in a 2D texture array or packed format, using interleaved fetch and mix operations to reduce texture lookups and improve stability.
summary: Trilinear Interpolation via Interleaved Fetches optimizes GPU memory bandwidth by reusing intermediate X-axis results during 3D trilinear interpolation on 2D texture arrays.
